command: pre-registration: R3b attention-logit binding steering, stage-1 H1-H4, after regions/split/smoke, before tuning

metrics.H1: wo_pre: steered - unsteered named-object hit share >= 0.20 (episode means), 95% CI excludes 0, one-sided bootstrap p (share <= 0) passes Holm
metrics.H2: su_pre: steered - unsteered >= -0.05; one-sided p = share of bootstrap diffs <= -0.05 passes Holm
metrics.H3: wg_post: as H1 on the own target (goal words, own-target region)
metrics.H4: su_post: as H2 on the own target
metrics.comparators: u21 (unsteered seed 21, noise floor), s_cf (counterfactual target), sweep over b, R2a arms recomputed
metrics.disclosure: seen before this row: R2a's published results (docs/PLAN_R2A.md, read.json; so u11 = R2a policy_sample on these observations is known: 0.08 on zs wrong-object, 0.61 on zs successes, pre-grasp); the oracle region job (projection orientation (0,0,1) on every task, median body-origin vs mask-centroid error 1.3-19.4 px; the calibration assertion was relaxed twice from < 16 px to 'same transform everywhere, < 30 px' after tasks 73 and 77 failed it at 17-19 px); a hand check of 12 random overlays (orientation and object identity right; the right moka pot's region in libero_90:38 also holds a 3-4 token strip under the stove); the split counts (tune 250; wo_pre 163, su_pre 394, wg_post 144, su_post 133); a 2-observation GPU smoke on tuning-pool observations (libero_90:14 t8, :16 t0; results/rs3/scratch/smoke): parity max |u11 - R2a draft_instr| = 0 and mean |steered - u11| of 0.001-0.003 (word / both) and 0.027 (expert L0-7 b8), no pointing computed.  Parse note: M1's step_key reads libero_90:16 ('stack the black bowl at the front on the black bowl in the middle') as object 'black bowl at the front on the black bowl', goal 'middle', so its object-word rows include the second bowl's words (kept as M1's parse, disclosed).  A python heredoc was attempted on the login node once during development and was blocked by the harness before running.
metrics.family: Holm over H1-H4 at alpha 0.05; stage-1 gate = H1 and H2; H3/H4 decide the goal phase in stage 2
metrics.readout: R2a's pointed(): integrated 10-step path, first candidate along the heading in a 5 cm corridor else best cosine, < 2 cm none; observation value = share of 12 chunks (seed 11) at the target
metrics.region: ORACLE: simulator segmentation, movable objects at recorded poses, robot hidden, agentview 16x16 tokens, >= 5% pixel coverage; disk 24 px fallbacks; goal sites = parent mask inside the disk
metrics.selection: grid site {word, expert, both} x layers {0-1, 0-3, 0-7} x b {2, 4, 8} on the tuning pool; admissible if g_named >= -0.02 and still <= +0.10; max g_cf; ties 0.005 -> smaller b, fewer layers, word<expert<both; none admissible -> max g_named; recorded as rs3_choice before any test observation is run
metrics.written_before: any steered chunk scored, any tuning statistic, any test observation run
